content:
maria: putting together a minimal manager checklist for new hires (first week + 30/60/90). trying to keep it copy-paste ready for manager emails. feedback?

tara: love that. include IT ticket timing (create 5 days before start) and buddy assignment.

ethan: add a tiny 1:1 agenda for Day1: intro, expectations, communication prefs, immediate blockers. makes managers less likely to wing it.

maria: good call both. also adding a bit about role-specific quickstarts (eng, support, sales) with links.

ethan: also remind managers to schedule skip-level within week1 and a check-in at end of week1.

onboard-bot: Reminder: Day1 checklist email will be sent to manager and buddy 24h prior to start.

maria: posting proposed checklist below. please flag any missing hard blockers and I'll publish to Notion.

```
Manager minimal first-week checklist
Pre-start (Week0):
- Create IT ticket for laptop + VPN + SSO (5 days before start)
- Assign buddy and add to calendar
- Share role doc, OKRs, roadmap links
Day1 (first day):
- 30m HR: payroll, benefits, policies
- 20m Manager 1:1: expectations, comms, immediate blockers, 3-week focus
- Team intro (15m) + add to roster
- Dev env / access check with buddy (eng only)
By Day5 (EOW):
- New hire can run basic workflows or tests
- Manager assigns a first small task and reviews 30/60/90 draft
- Schedule skip-level and week2 customer shadow if relevant
30/60/90 (manager-owned):
- 30d: baseline ramp complete, first small deliverable
- 60d: deeper cross-team contributions
- 90d: independent shipping and proposed next goals
```

maria: thanks  I'll add links and publish. if you want role-specific variants, DM me and I'll create templates.
_notes: Single Slack thread as a continuous string. No title field per agents.md.
